notes.title: Screenshot Saturday #3
notes.content:
Hello, fellow player!

It is Screenshot Saturday again- a day when indie developers shares its game's progress. 

This week I was mainly concentrated on gamedesign. Even so, I added a lot of cool stuff in the game. Let's go! 🦜

[h1]Fishes [/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37655344/d3fa4f7116c0f68f62ac65b2b7e05eb15a42be06.gif[/img]
Yes, now there is some fishes besides the fleshless one!

[h1]Skeletons [/h1]
I've created concepts of some skeletons. Let's take a look! 💀
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37655344/3a07657ab6fe3804a7841b3a1273180a48476dc1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37655344/5b6a378392340b51c8bdecbbfcef5a62425f1c07.png[/img]

I also finished the main menu screen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37655344/344587a1ca728687ceec7a44467f68d5779c1b3a.png[/img]
